stance_rationale: Headline IC diagnostics and alpha_scores time-series shape pass, but the package fails hard process and implementation gates: lockbox evidence is used for model selection, liquidity/universe construction is below mandate and same-day volume based, and mandatory challenge/lineage artifacts are absent.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet has 132136 rows, 60 monthly sig_dates, Date x Ticker x score columns, no dates after 2026-05-15. Risk remains because alpha_vector exposes only latest top-30 and requested weights.csv schedule artifact is absent.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Package rationale selects M6 using lockbox rank_ic/t-stat comparisons against M7 before post-judge lockbox seal, which is process future-reference under AX-002.
No NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN pattern found in WT_D20260514_013 scripts; parent WT_008 layer A uses Z_Score_Aligned.
Parent feature registry states Usable_Date <= sig_date through load_month_factors; final package does not expose row-level Usable_Date proof.
WT_D20260514_008/build_features_pool.R calls load_month_factors(sd) for Factor DB monthly layer; WT_D20260514_013 itself inherits parquet artifacts.
Parent scripts show lagged vol/macro/regime construction; no same-day M6 regime overlay found in the alpha package.
WT_007 shows quarterly DART 45d lag for disclosure velocity, but annual May lag proof is not present in the package or required factor_engine_proposal.R.
WT_008 universe uses snap <- rd_full[Date == sd] and ADV20 with align='right', so the liquidity screen includes same-day trading value; LIQ_THRESHOLD is also 5e7, below the 2e8 mandate.

critical_concerns.description: Lockbox metrics are not merely reported; they are used to justify M6 over M7 and the 40% blend, contaminating the sealed evaluation layer before Judge/S6. This is process future-reference, not clean out-of-sample validation.

The alpha production universe is built on a 5e7 20d ADV threshold and same-day ADV20, while the mandate requires KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150 with 20d TV >= 2e8 and C10 no same-day liquidity. RF-A5 remains unresolved, and the package defers the hard filter to optimizer.
No challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, or factor_engine_proposal.R exists for this worktask, despite the role prompt requiring them for No Silent Override and lineage verification.

RF-A2 is not clean: M6 lockbox ICIR 0.935 is below M5_LGB lockbox ICIR 1.082, and M6 net SR 1.096 is far below M5 net SR 1.843. The package argues rank IC only, but the red flag is explicitly composite ICIR versus best single factor.

Production-overlap evidence is materially weaker than full-panel evidence: STR_1715 overlap is only 15.62%, rank IC drops to 0.0409, and Q10 monotonicity is 0.6121 versus the 0.80 checklist threshold.

RF-A7 is not triggered for alpha_scores.parquet, but the package still emits a latest-date top-30 alpha_vector and the requested weights.csv schedule is absent. A downstream consumer could reproduce the Iter 4 single-snapshot bug.

The academic mechanism fails the alpha checklist format: references have no page anchors, mechanism text is not under 200 characters, KR applicability is asserted mostly through diagnostics, and 5-spec simultaneous regression evidence is absent.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet is a real time-series panel with 60 monthly sig_dates and variable ticker counts, so RF-A7 is false at the alpha-score artifact level.
Full ML-panel lockbox rank_ic 0.0732, ICIR 0.9352, Harvey t 3.8464, and dsr_z_n5 8.4747 clear the numeric Alpha Lab thresholds.
Parent WT_008 feature build shows load_month_factors(sd) for monthly Factor DB features and no NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN pattern was found in the reviewed alpha scripts.
Pooled correlation versus STR_1715 is low at Pearson 0.0204 and Spearman 0.0293, so the orthogonality claim has some support before universe and lockbox objections.
unresolved_disputes: weights.csv and covariance.parquet for WT-D20260514_013 were not present at the requested paths, so schedule, turnover, PSD, and condition-number claims cannot be verified.
Other 3-agent context packages and challenge notes were not present in qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260514_013, so AX-008 2-source PASS cannot be established.
Top-decile and latest top-30 membership inside KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150 with 20d TV >= 2e8 remains unproven.
No 255-month Forge subsample comparison is attached, despite the package itself naming 60-month sample-period bias.
No page-specific academic references or KR-specific causal mechanism validation are attached.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that 24-month lockbox/full-ML-panel M6 evidence can justify production admission into a KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150, LIQ >= 2e8, final top-20 blend without lockbox contamination or alpha decay after the universe filter.
rebuttal_required: Rebuild or prove the universe using t-1 20d trading value >= 2e8 and KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150 membership at each sig_date.
Separate pre-lockbox model selection from lockbox reporting; show M6 choice was fixed before reading folds 3 and 4 or rerun with a newly sealed holdout.
Provide challenge_note.md covering RF-A1 through RF-A7 and artifact_lineage.json showing write_json then record_lineage order.
Report RF-A2 honestly using ICIR and net SR versus M5_LGB and M7_XGB_CostAware, not only rank IC.
Attach weights.csv, covariance.parquet, and 255-month Forge comparison before any admission claim.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I do not accept the package's self-pass framing: the strongest artifact is the alpha_scores time-series, but the admission argument relies on contaminated lockbox comparisons and a universe/liquidity construction that violates the mandate.

alpha_specific_questions: Can M6 still beat M5_LGB and M7_XGB_CostAware on ICIR and net SR after applying KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150 and t-1 LIQ >= 2e8?
Was M6 selected before any fold 3-4 lockbox metric was computed, or is the current package using lockbox as a model-selection set?
Does the alpha vector remain valid when alpha_scores are updated through the current as_of_date rather than stopping at 2026-01-30?
Can C10 be repaired by shifting ADV20 to t-1 without changing top-decile IC and monotonicity?
